fields.name: ShardDataConnection<TConfiguration> MapOutputAsync family
fields.contract: For a Query contract, MapOutputAsync returns a TModel instance populated from the query's output parameters and zero to eight data-reader result sets (TReaderResult0..TReaderResult7, each constrained new()). Variants select: the reader-result arity, 0 through 8; whether the method constructs the TModel via a parameterless constructor or instead populates a TModel instance the caller supplies; and whether a named parameter is bound to the endpoint's current shard identifier before execution.
